events.title: Two haulers swap loads mid-lane
environment: lane midpoint marker (lane_furniture lane pin as dressing, optional)
events.arrangement: Two haulers converge on a point between stations, park bow-to-stern 8 wu apart, offset like trucks in a layby
events.startConditions: Two hauler jobs whose origin/destination pairs cross; midpoint within a traveled pocket
events.visibleCue: Two heavy hulls leaving their lanes for the same empty spot - freight does not sightsee

phases.name: converge
phases.visible: Both fly visible straight legs to the same point, one loaded (amber heartbeat) one empty (dim bar)

phases.name: park
phases.visible: Nose-to-tail hold; running lights only

phases.name: swap
phases.visible: Loaded one runs spilling_the_count, empty one mouth_open; the strobes visibly TRADE - one dims as the other warms

phases.name: split
phases.visible: They depart on each other's original headings - the load changed trucks

events.completion: Both reach their (swapped) destinations; manifests transferred

interruptions.outcome: Survivor completes its original run - no swap, no stall

playerInterference: Scan mid-swap: two manifests in motion
Rob the layby - both hulls parked
Park in the layby spot first and they hold off, waiting visibly
events.criminalOpportunity: A scheduled layby is a pattern: watch it twice and you know where freight parks
events.fallback: Rendezvous point unreachable: both keep original runs (the swap is opportunistic, never load-bearing)
events.notes: Demoted from first15: the manifest handover between two live jobs needs a small ownership-transfer helper the kernel does not have yet.

events.title: Courier threads past bulk traffic
events.arrangement: Hauler plodding the lane; courier approaching from astern at 2x speed, offset one hull-width
events.startConditions: Courier and loaded hauler on the same lane heading with closing speed
events.visibleCue: A fast dim-bar hull closing on a slow amber-heartbeat one - empty overtakes heavy, always

phases.name: close
phases.visible: Courier holds lane offset, closing fast

phases.name: pass
phases.visible: Overtake one hull-width abeam; hauler holds course exactly - right of way by mass

phases.name: pull_away
phases.visible: Courier rejoins the lane centre ahead and shrinks toward the speed-revealed band

events.completion: Courier gone up-lane; hauler unchanged - a five-second story about who hurries and who cannot

interruptions.outcome: Courier swaps to the other side - one lateral step, no drama

playerInterference: Draft the courier
Interdict it (couriers are the classic toll target)
Nothing - this event exists to be scenery
events.criminalOpportunity: A courier that ALWAYS overtakes on the same side is a courier a pirate can plan around
events.fallback: Either despawns: the other just continues its lane
events.notes: Pure traffic steering - an overtake offset when closing on same-heading slower traffic. The cheapest event in the library and among the most world-selling.

events.title: Station launches a cargo capsule
environment: capsule object (pickup class, everyday_space_kit pod as dressing)
events.arrangement: Capsule emerges from the station's cargo face and boosts down-lane on a fixed ballistic leg
events.startConditions: Station economy tick emits an outbound batch; existing cargo_tractor station-side profile available
events.visibleCue: The station's cargo face runs the tractor-tether pod profile (existing station-side VFX) - then something actually LEAVES

phases.name: stage
phases.visible: cargo_tractor profile: pod rails + tether, capsule sliding to the launch point

phases.name: launch
phases.visible: Capsule boosts away on a straight leg with a small clean plume - unmanned, unlit cabin, one strobe

phases.name: coast
phases.visible: Capsule coasts down-lane, strobing; optionally a hauler alters to parallel it (informal escort)

phases.name: exit
phases.visible: Capsule leaves the pocket toward the neighbor sector (despawn at boundary)

events.completion: Capsule exits; the station face goes quiet

interruptions.outcome: Cargo pickups scatter on its vector; station launches no replacement this cycle

playerInterference: Chase and crack the capsule (it is cargo with a strobe)
Follow it to the sector boundary
Tether-catch it - it is just mass
events.criminalOpportunity: An unmanned launcher on a schedule is the belt's ATM: the crime writes itself, the response (patrol launch profile) already exists
events.aftermath: Cracked capsules leave a pickup field mid-lane that sweeper events can later clean
events.fallback: No launch face resolvable: the tractor profile plays without a capsule (today's behavior, unchanged)
events.notes: Extends the existing station-side profile with one real spawned object flying one straight line. The capsule is a pickup with velocity.

events.title: Convoy forms before departure
events.arrangement: Haulers arrive singly and park in a visible line abreast 10 wu apart off the apron; escort takes the flank slot last
events.startConditions: Existing convoy encounter script scheduled; departure T minus ~90 s
events.visibleCue: Parked heavy hulls ACCUMULATING in a line - one is a wait, two is a queue, three is a convoy forming

phases.name: gather
phases.visible: Haulers arrive at intervals and slot into line, each with the parked load strobe

phases.name: escort_arrives
phases.visible: Escort takes position ahead-flank, pin facing the CLIENTS (borrowed-shadow geometry: guns out, pin in)

phases.name: spine_up
phases.visible: All hulls light spine_wake in sequence down the line - the visible ignition ripple

phases.name: depart
phases.visible: Line rolls out in order, escort holding relative station

events.completion: Convoy leaves as the existing convoy encounter; the formation event is its visible prologue

interruptions.outcome: Convoy departs unescorted after timeout - visibly more vulnerable, and pirate events key on exactly this

playerInterference: Join the line (the game already tracks convoy adjacency)
Note the cargo and sell the tip (future contraband/rumor)
Attack during spine_up - the one moment all engines are lit but nobody is moving
events.criminalOpportunity: Formation broadcasts the convoy's size, wealth and escort count to everyone watching for free
events.aftermath: The departing convoy is the existing convoy encounter - this event chains into it
events.fallback: A hauler despawns in line: gap closes, convoy departs smaller
events.diagramMermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant H1 as Hauler 1
  participant H2 as Hauler 2
  participant H3 as Hauler 3
  participant E as Escort
  H1->>H1: parks at apron (heavy_burn idle)
  H2->>H1: slots in line abreast
  H3->>H2: slots in line abreast
  E->>E: takes flank, pin toward clients
  Note over H1,E: spine_wake ripples down the line
  H1->>H1: rolls out
  H2->>H1: follows in order
  E->>E: holds relative station

events.title: Truss delivery arrives at the build site

participants.note: runs as a static site prop until donor hull promoted

environment: construction site (world site or everyday_space_kit truss composition)
events.arrangement: Rig holds over the frame; hauler approaches the marked delivery point 20 wu off the rig's crane side
events.startConditions: Construction site active in-sector; hauler job with the site as destination
events.visibleCue: A loaded hauler heading somewhere that is NOT a station - freight off the lanes means a site is eating materials

phases.name: inbound
phases.visible: Hauler's loaded leg to the site, wide stacking approach

phases.name: handoff
phases.visible: Hauler holds; rig's crane traverses toward it; spilling_the_count on one side, hoist line paying out on the other

phases.name: hoist
phases.visible: A truss segment (prop) rides the hook from hauler to frame - the one object visibly changing hands

phases.name: outbound
phases.visible: Hauler departs empty; rig swings back over the frame

events.completion: Site inventory ticks up; the frame gains one visible segment (prop instanced at the next frame slot)

interruptions.outcome: Truss pickups spawn at the kill; the site's next delivery window doubles - visible starvation

playerInterference: Deliver salvaged truss yourself (sell at the site)
Rob the inbound leg
Watch the frame actually grow - the reward for paying attention
events.criminalOpportunity: Site deliveries run on a visible schedule with a fixed route - the textbook interdiction setup
events.aftermath: PERSISTENT: the frame keeps its added segments across the session - construction that visibly progresses
events.fallback: Site absent/complete: hauler reroutes to the nearest station (ordinary run)

events.title: Tanker waits out a red berth
environment: station with one marked hazmat berth (everyday_space_kit berth props as dressing)
events.arrangement: Tanker parks at a marked hold point 60 wu off the dock face, nose at the berth, NOT approaching
events.startConditions: Tanker arrives while another ship occupies the berth window
events.visibleCue: A heavy hull parked in the open pointing at a station and refusing to close - the pose IS the queue

phases.name: arrive_hold
phases.visible: Tanker takes the hold point and station-keeps, mass strobe idling

phases.name: queue_visible
phases.visible: The occupying ship finishes its dock cycle (existing hauler_dock profile) and departs past the waiting tanker

phases.name: cleared
phases.visible: Tanker lights spine_wake the moment the departing hull crosses its bow - the courtesy nobody wrote down

phases.name: approach
phases.visible: The long careful volatile approach, wide and slow

events.completion: Tanker docks (existing dock verb); the hold point empties

interruptions.outcome: Tanker gives up and departs for the alternate station - fuel goes elsewhere, visibly

playerInterference: Take the berth first and the tanker WAITS on you - the world queues behind the player
Scan the parked tanker: full volatile manifest, zero escort
events.criminalOpportunity: A queue point is a schedule: the same hold spot fills at the same times
events.aftermath: If the tanker diverts, station fuel price ticks up (market news blip)
events.fallback: Occupier never departs (stuck): tanker's timeout diverts it - the queue never deadlocks
events.notes: Berth occupancy is one boolean on the station slot, not a full berth-queue system; the FULL queue (multiple waiters, priorities) is the future.berthQueue mechanic and stays out of scope here.

events.title: Ore barge tops off from two miners

participants.note: ship_mule heavy variant until donor promoted

environment: asteroid field with two active miner slots
events.arrangement: Barge parks central to both rocks; miners shuttle to it alternately instead of flying home
events.startConditions: Two miners working the same field while a barge-class hauler is unassigned
events.visibleCue: A big hull parking in the MIDDLE of a field, doing nothing - a mother ship pose, and the miners' return legs suddenly shorten

phases.name: anchor
phases.visible: Barge takes station central, floods on over its baskets

phases.name: shuttle_1
phases.visible: Miner A runs its loaded leg to the barge instead of home; count-spill between them

phases.name: shuttle_2
phases.visible: Miner B does the same from the other side - the barge becomes the field's visible center of gravity

phases.name: haul_home
phases.visible: Barge departs very heavy, very slow; miners keep cutting with their commutes halved

events.completion: Barge delivers a double load to the refinery; the field keeps producing without pause

interruptions.outcome: Miners revert to their own home legs; huge spill field at the wreck

playerInterference: The anchored barge is a fixed fat target - guarding it or robbing it are both obvious
Sell your own ore to it (it is a mobile buyer)
events.criminalOpportunity: One hull now carries two crews' shifts - the raid math improves every minute it sits
events.aftermath: Refinery inventory jump on delivery; miners' cycle continues
events.fallback: One miner lost: the barge waits one extra window then hauls half-full
events.notes: Retargets the miners' home waypoint to the barge's position while anchored - the same route-retarget trick the miner-calls-hauler event uses, doubled.

events.title: Express liner passes through on schedule

participants.note: liner_shuttle donor hull when promoted; window-row is the read

environment: lane crossing the pocket end to end
events.arrangement: High-speed straight transit at lane center, never deviating, entering and leaving at the speed-revealed band
events.startConditions: Express spawn timer (the role exists with speed 247 and a boost-lane path already)
events.visibleCue: Every other hull gives way a lane-width - the wake of deference arrives before the liner does

phases.name: herald
phases.visible: Traffic ahead side-steps in sequence; the empty corridor forms

phases.name: pass
phases.visible: The liner crosses the whole pocket at V3 boost speed, cabin rows lit, dead straight

phases.name: wake
phases.visible: Traffic drifts back to lane center behind it; the corridor heals

events.completion: Gone. The event is the punctuation mark of a working day

interruptions.outcome: The liner shifts one width and does NOT slow - schedule beats courtesy

playerInterference: Race it (you will need physics-earned overspeed)
Interdict it - the highest-profile crime the region offers (patrol response is immediate)
events.criminalOpportunity: Its schedule is exact; that is the entire vulnerability
events.fallback: No liner spawn available: the event simply does not fire (it is pure texture)
events.notes: The express role, its 247 speed and boost-lane pathing already exist; the give-way ripple is the passive-avoidance radius briefly enlarged for the liner.
